show.description: To save her family’s falling empire, Meera is forced to marry the powerful Advait. But the man everyone mocked, her innocent husband Ishaan, suddenly regains memories of his past life. He is actually Anant Maharaj, a legendary and unstoppable force. Now he returns, not as a fool, but as Meera’s protector - ready to destroy anyone who dares to take her away. Watch now!
